hero.title: Everyone solves problems. I make sure we're solving the right ones.
hero.deck: I build the first version myself, then grow the team that takes it to production. Tenth employee at SOPHiA GENETICS, now 400+ people. From thermal engineering to VP, by way of software, data visualisation, photography and now AI.

ribbon.title: From engineer to VP, still hands-on
ribbon.caption: Each bar is a role, drawn to scale. Height marks seniority. The thin bands show photography, engineering and data visualisation that never stopped.

notes.title: 1995 · Thermal & simulation engineer
notes.text: 3D finite-element simulations, extending a FORTRAN solver with new physics.

notes.title: 2008 · Photography
notes.text: A sabbatical for visual studies, then exhibitions and awards. It shaped how I see data.

notes.title: 2013 · SOPHiA, tenth employee
notes.text: Joined as data visualisation engineer. Built the first platform UI myself.

notes.title: 2018 · First VP
notes.text: Functional & UX design, after growing the front-end team I started.

notes.title: 2019 · AI & deep learning
notes.text: A year invested in machine learning, before returning to SOPHiA to lead product.

notes.title: 2025 · VP, Design & Innovation
notes.text: A small team focused on product vision and strategic features.

principles.title: Clarify first
principles.text: Speed matters less than direction. I make sure the team is solving the right problem before anyone writes a line.

principles.title: Build it myself
principles.text: I prototype the first version hands-on, with AI as a daily tool. Deep enough to direct it, fast enough to ship before the spec is done.

principles.title: Scale through teams
principles.text: I grow the team that takes what works to production, and delegate with the credibility of having built it.

principles.title: Data into stories
principles.text: Complex datasets turned into clear interfaces people actually use. D3.js has been my core tool since 2012.

close.title: Need someone who clarifies before building, and builds before delegating? Let's talk.

sections.label: Profile
paragraphs: I'm a product, design, and engineering leader with a data‑ and facts‑driven mindset, focused on turning complex business needs into clear, usable experiences. My background blends Product Management, Data Visualization, Data Engineering, and Frontend Engineering — grounded in curiosity about the underlying domain and strong attention to detail.

I joined Sophia Genetics as its tenth employee — the company is now 400+ people. In more than 10 years I've built tools and platforms at the intersection of data and healthcare, from the founding stage through scale.

sections.label: Expertise
paragraphs: Product Management — I frame ambiguous problems into actionable roadmaps, bridging business stakeholders and engineering teams with structured reasoning and clear communication.
Data Visualization — I build interactive charts and dashboards that make complex datasets legible. D3.js has been my core tool for over a decade, from genomics platforms to business metrics.
Frontend Engineering — I write production code. From UI prototypes to full data pipelines, I step in and build when it matters — not just specify.

sections.label: Approach
paragraphs: I am recognised for my high-level communication skills and structured reasoning. I help teams frame problems clearly, make faster decisions and share knowledge across departments — in major presentations as much as in day-to-day collaboration.
I'm a hands-on person who steps in to move work forward. I combine this with a track record of building dashboards spanning business outcomes, platform usage, and software development metrics.

I work AI-natively — using these tools daily to prototype, reason, and ship faster. What I bring beyond the tools is critical thinking and fundamental AI/ML knowledge: the ability to direct AI well, evaluate its output, and understand what it means to deploy it responsibly in regulated environments like healthcare.

sections.label: Background
paragraphs: I hold a first master's degree in Mathematics, Fluid Mechanics, and Thermodynamics, followed by a second master's in Computer Science. That blend of rigorous science and applied engineering has shaped how I think about every problem.

I've always been passionate about data and the art of telling stories through data visualizations — that sweet spot where logic and design come together. Outside of work, I love reading, running, and photography, which keep me creative and observant.
